summary.headline: International project management and business development across MENA, East Asia, and Europe
paragraphs: My career combines international project and business management with risk intelligence and strategic communications. I have worked at the interface between Japanese organizations and overseas decision-makers, developing opportunities, negotiating commercial matters, and managing relationships essential to project progress.

At Nikken Sekkei, from April 2007 to August 2026, my responsibilities encompassed business development, client relations, and project management across planning, proposals, design, procurement, and site coordination. I brought together clients, senior management, consultants, and multidisciplinary teams to advance complex international assignments.

My project experience includes developments with a combined value exceeding USD 10 billion, including One Za’abeel in Dubai, Tadawul Tower in Riyadh, the E-JUST campus in Egypt, the Grand Mosque expansion in Mecca, and the Futur Camp Nou redevelopment in Barcelona. My responsibilities varied by assignment and included project acquisition, client relations, and project coordination.

As part of the international public relations team, I led overseas communications activities covering award submissions, corporate publications, project marketing materials, and executive client tours. I also supported overseas expansion and the establishment of international offices, linking business development with corporate communications.

Earlier, at Tokio Marine & Nichido Risk Consulting, I assessed geopolitical, security, and disaster risks in the Middle East and East Asia. I prepared analytical reports and strategic intelligence for Japanese companies and government agencies, supporting overseas business planning, market-entry decisions, and risk management.

about.headline: Connecting Japanese organizations with partners across MENA, East Asia, and Europe
about.intro:
I am an international project management and business development executive from the western Mediterranean, with more than 20 years of professional experience in Japan and overseas. My career spans major architectural, infrastructure, and urban development projects across the Middle East, North Africa, East Asia, and Europe, combining business development, project leadership, and executive-level relationship management.

My expertise includes international market entry, strategic alliances, commercial negotiations, and the leadership of multidisciplinary project teams. I have represented Japanese organizations in dealings with government agencies, royal family representatives, investors, and developers, building consensus and aligning commercial priorities, technical requirements, schedules, costs, and risks.

Alongside these responsibilities, I have led international public relations and corporate branding initiatives and supported overseas expansion and office openings. My earlier experience in geopolitical, security, and disaster risk analysis informs my understanding of international business environments. Working in Japanese, English, French, and Arabic, I combine strategic analysis, cross-cultural communication, and practical project leadership.
